title: Safely Increment Across Threads
goal: Increment a shared counter from multiple spawned threads using Arc and Mutex.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Shared State

hints: An Arc only gives shared references. You must lock the inner Mutex to gain mutable access.
MutexGuard implements DerefMut, so dereferencing it yields the inner value.
explanation: Calling lock().unwrap() on a Mutex acquires exclusive access and returns a MutexGuard. Because MutexGuard implements DerefMut, using *guard dereferences the guard to reach the inner i32 value. Calling borrow_mut() fails with E0599 because that is a RefCell method, not a Mutex method. Attempting guard += 1 directly on the guard fails with E0369 because addition is not implemented for MutexGuard.
